about_short_description.short_description: ZeroPath is a Computer and Network Security firm that discover and fix exploitable software vulnerabilities.

product.name: ZeroPath AI-Powered Security Platform
product.description: An AI-driven static application security testing (SAST) tool that scans code repositories to detect and fix software vulnerabilities including broken authentication, business logic flaws, and dependency issues.

product.name: ZeroPath Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
product.description: A component of ZeroPath that scans software dependencies to identify known vulnerabilities, assess their exploitability, and detect end-of-life components.

product.name: ZeroPath Secrets Detection
product.description: A scanning service that detects secrets such as API keys and credentials in code with validation to minimize false positives.

identifier.value: ZeroPath Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security Scanning

product.name: ZeroPath Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security Scanning
product.description: A service that analyzes Infrastructure as Code configurations to identify security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.

identifier.value: ZeroPath Automated Patch Generation and Modification

product.name: ZeroPath Automated Patch Generation and Modification
product.description: A feature that automatically generates and allows customization of code patches to fix identified security vulnerabilities.

product.name: Zero
product.description: A persistent AI agent that autonomously builds and manages an organization’s entire application security program using plain-English workflows.
